clips.send: A worried parent sends this to a sibling who treats every symptom with a new pill - anxiety about a system built to medicate first, not prevent.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau shares a number that stopped him mid-sentence: Americans take more prescription drugs than every other country in the world combined.

His view: it isn't one single cause - it's what's allowed on our plates every day, long before anyone needs a prescription.

He lists what follows that pattern: more illness, less energy, and bodies that need more help just to function the way they should.

Kevin Trudeau's own rule: start at the kitchen table, not the medicine cabinet.

What's one thing on your plate you'd want to question?

#kevintrudeau #health #nutrition #wellness #naturalhealth #wbdaily

clips.send: A meat-eater who felt guilty at a vegan dinner sends this to the friend who guilt-tripped them - vindication, with a little awe at George Burns living to 100.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to the actual 100-year-olds living around the world - still gardening, still carrying groceries, still active - and most of them are not vegan.

His favorite example: George Burns, who smoked six cigars a day, drank three martinis, ate steak every night, and performed on stage at 100 years old. The doctors who told him to quit those habits died before he did.

Kevin Trudeau's point isn't "eat whatever you want" - it's that a vegan diet isn't automatically the healthier choice. What matters more, in his view, is the quality of what's on the plate.

What's one food rule you were taught that you've started to question?

#kevintrudeau #nutrition #longevity #centenarians #healthyaging #wbdaily
